description: Defines the CertVerifyProc class and related factory for certificate verification, including verification flags, methods, and support for different trust stores within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CertVerifyProc
classes.description: Performs certificate path building and verification, supporting thread safety and multiple trust store options.

classes.name: CertVerifyProcFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating instances of CertVerifyProc with configurable parameters.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies a certificate against a hostname with optional trust anchors and revocation checking flags.

methods.name: SupportsAdditionalTrustAnchors
methods.description: Indicates if the implementation supports passing additional trust anchors.

methods.name: CreateSystemVerifyProc
methods.description: Creates a system default certificate verifier, if supported.

methods.name: CreateBuiltinVerifyProc
methods.description: Creates a verifier using the system trust store.

methods.name: CreateBuiltinWithChromeRootStore
methods.description: Creates a verifier using the Chrome Root Store with optional custom data.
